name: brandfetch
description: Brandfetch brand/context/search tools with private profiles and approved local downloads.
long_description: 14 shared tools: 12 reads/helpers and two confirmed operations. Current Brand API V2, bounded comparisons, explicit identifier routes, browser-only hotlinks and private approved asset downloads.

token_file.title: Private token-only file
token_file.description: Absolute owner-private Brand API key file; overrides the environment key.

read_only.title: Read only
read_only.description: Hide and refuse prefetch crawling and private local asset downloads; reads can still use provider quota.

api_key.title: Brand API key
api_key.description: Private REST Brand API Bearer key; official MCP bf1 tokens are not interchangeable.

allow_destructive.title: Allow confirmed mutations
allow_destructive.description: Permit mutation execution only when the tool call explicitly confirms the exact action. Disable to refuse all mutations.

client_id.title: Logo API client ID
client_id.description: Separate application client ID for search and browser-only logo URLs. Not a Brand API key.
